description: This file defines a Vue.js composable hook 'usePaginate' for handling paginated data fetching, including state management, API calls, and optional prefetching. It also includes utility functions for pagination parameters and query processing.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Fetches data from API using provided parameters, handles errors.

methods.name: getPageParams
methods.description: Calculates limit and offset for pagination based on page size and current page.

methods.name: getQueryParams
methods.description: Processes query object to remove null or empty string values.

methods.name: defaultNormalizer
methods.description: Default data normalizer that returns data unchanged.
